description:
Activate Zimone's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Retreat to Coralhelm and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Guildless Commons.
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Zimone.
Repeat.
